title: Smart Data Models - OSDU Data Definitions - Wellbore
description: A hole in the ground extending from a point at the earth's surface to the maximum point of penetration. (OSDU kind osdu:wks:master-data--Wellbore:1.5.1, OSDU Data Definitions v0.30.1. The attributes of the record's `data` block are entity attributes, with their OSDU names verbatim; the record envelope keeps osduId (OSDU `id`), kind, tags, ancestry, meta and legal; acl, version and the system audit fields are left out. OSDU abstract schemas used by nested attributes are in $defs.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Wellbore:<namespace>:<code>, built from the OSDU record id <namespace>:master-data--Wellbore:<code> (kept in osduId).

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Wellbore'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. It may correspond to the OSDU system property createTime.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification. It may correspond to the OSDU system property modifyTime.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data (not to be confused with the OSDU attribute `Source`).

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

osduId.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/id'. OSDU record id (renamed from `id`, an NGSI-LD reserved term). Previously called ResourceID or SRN which identifies this OSDU resource object without version.
osduId.title: Entity ID

kind.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/kind'. The schema identification for the OSDU resource object following the pattern {Namespace}:{Source}:{Type}:{VersionMajor}.{VersionMinor}.{VersionPatch}. The versioning scheme follows the semantic versioning, https://semver.org/. For this model: osdu:wks:master-data--Wellbore:1.5.1 (or another version of the same kind).
kind.title: Entity Kind

ancestry.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/ancestry'. The links to data, which constitute the inputs, from which this record instance is derived.
ancestry.title: Ancestry

TechnicalAssurances.title: Technical Assurances
TechnicalAssurances.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/abstract/AbstractMaster.1.2.0.json#/properties/TechnicalAssurances'. Describes a record's overall suitability for general business consumption in context of one or more workflows/personas based on data quality and reviewer's decisions. Clarifications: Since Certified is the highest classification of suitable quality, any further change or versioning of a Certified record should be carefully considered and justified. If a Technical Assurance value is not populated then one can assume the data has not been evaluated or its quality is unknown (=Unevaluated). Technical Assurance values are not intended to be used for the identification of a single "preferred" or "definitive" record by comparison with other records.

FacilityID.title: External Facility Identifier
FacilityID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/abstract/AbstractFacility.1.1.0.json#/properties/FacilityID'. Native identifier from a Master Data Management System or other trusted source external to OSDU - stored here in order to allow for multi-system connection and synchronization. If used, the "Source" property should identify that source system.

FacilityTypeID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/abstract/AbstractFacility.1.1.0.json#/properties/FacilityTypeID'. The definition of a kind of capability to perform a business function or a service.

FacilityOperators.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/abstract/AbstractFacility.1.1.0.json#/properties/FacilityOperators'. The history of operator organizations of the facility.

InitialOperatorID.description: Relationship. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/abstract/AbstractFacility.1.1.0.json#/properties/InitialOperatorID'. A initial operator organization ID; the organization ID may also be found in the FacilityOperatorOrganisationID of the FacilityOperator array providing the actual dates. In OSDU this is a record id matching ^[\w\-\.]+:master-data\-\-Organisation:[\w\-\.\:\%]+:[0-9]*$; here it is the NGSI-LD id of the Organisation entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Organisation:<namespace>:<code>).

CurrentOperatorID.description: Relationship. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/abstract/AbstractFacility.1.1.0.json#/properties/CurrentOperatorID'. The current operator organization ID; the organization ID may also be found in the FacilityOperatorOrganisationID of the FacilityOperator array providing the actual dates. In OSDU this is a record id matching ^[\w\-\.]+:master-data\-\-Organisation:[\w\-\.\:\%]+:[0-9]*$; here it is the NGSI-LD id of the Organisation entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Organisation:<namespace>:<code>).

DataSourceOrganisationID.description: Relationship. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/abstract/AbstractFacility.1.1.0.json#/properties/DataSourceOrganisationID'. The main source of the header information. In OSDU this is a record id matching ^[\w\-\.]+:master-data\-\-Organisation:[\w\-\.\:\%]+:[0-9]*$; here it is the NGSI-LD id of the Organisation entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Organisation:<namespace>:<code>).

OperatingEnvironmentID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/abstract/AbstractFacility.1.1.0.json#/properties/OperatingEnvironmentID'. Identifies the Facility's general location as being onshore vs. offshore.

FacilityDescription.title: Facility Description
FacilityDescription.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/abstract/AbstractFacility.1.1.0.json#/properties/FacilityDescription'. A descriptive text or remark about the Facility.

FacilityStates.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/abstract/AbstractFacility.1.1.0.json#/properties/FacilityStates'. The history of life cycle states the facility has been through.

FacilityEvents.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/abstract/AbstractFacility.1.1.0.json#/properties/FacilityEvents'. A list of key facility events.

FacilitySpecifications.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/abstract/AbstractFacility.1.1.0.json#/properties/FacilitySpecifications'. facilitySpecification maintains the specification like slot name, wellbore drilling permit number, rig name etc.

WellID.description: Relationship. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/WellID'. In OSDU this is a record id matching ^[\w\-\.]+:master-data\-\-Well:[\w\-\.\:\%]+:[0-9]*$; here it is the NGSI-LD id of the Well entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Well:<namespace>:<code>).

SequenceNumber.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/SequenceNumber'. A number that indicates the order in which wellbores were drilled.

VerticalMeasurements.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/VerticalMeasurements'. List of all depths and elevations pertaining to the wellbore, like, plug back measured depth, total measured depth, KB elevation

VerticalMeasurementID.description: The ID for a distinct vertical measurement within the Wellbore VerticalMeasurements array so that it may be referenced by other vertical measurements if necessary.

RigID.title: Rig ID
RigID.description: The relationship to the rig, which was used while this vertical measurement was in active use.

DrillingReasons.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/DrillingReasons'. The history of drilling reasons of the wellbore.

WellboreReasonID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/WellboreReasonID'. The relationship to a reference-data record explaining the reason why this wellbore was drilled.

KickOffWellbore.description: Relationship. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/KickOffWellbore'. This is a pointer to the parent wellbore. The wellbore that starts from top has no parent. In OSDU this is a record id matching ^[\w\-\.]+:master-data\-\-Wellbore:[\w\-\.\:\%]+:[0-9]*$; here it is the NGSI-LD id of the Wellbore entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Wellbore:<namespace>:<code>).

TrajectoryTypeID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/TrajectoryTypeID'. Profile Type [Wellbore Trajectory Type] is the general geometry of the wellbore relative to the vertical plane. The specific criteria for Profile Type may vary by operator or regulator. The facet value may change if conditions encountered during drilling are not what was planned or permitted.

DefinitiveTrajectoryID.description: Relationship. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/DefinitiveTrajectoryID'. SRN of Wellbore Trajectory which is considered the authoritative or preferred version. In OSDU this is a record id matching ^[\w\-\.]+:work-product-component\-\-WellboreTrajectory:[\w\-\.\:\%]+:[0-9]*$; here it is the NGSI-LD id of the WellboreTrajectory entity (urn:ngsi-ld:WellboreTrajectory:<namespace>:<code>).

TargetFormation.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/TargetFormation'. The Formation of interest for which the Wellbore is drilled to interact with. The Wellbore may terminate in a lower formation if the requirement is to drill through the entirety of the target formation, therefore this is not necessarily the Formation at TD.

FormationNameAtTotalDepth.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/FormationNameAtTotalDepth'. The name of the formation encountered at total depth. The value is not controlled by any reference value list.

DefaultVerticalMeasurementID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/DefaultVerticalMeasurementID'. The default datum reference point, or zero depth point, used to determine other points vertically in a wellbore.  References an entry in the Vertical Measurements array of this wellbore.

ProjectedBottomHoleLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/ProjectedBottomHoleLocation'. The bottom hole location of the wellbore denoted by a projected horizontal coordinate reference system (Horizontal CRS), such a UTM zone. 'Projected' in this property does not mean 'planned' or 'projected-to-bit'. If both GeographicBottomHoleLocation and ProjectedBottomHoleLocation properties are populated on this wellbore, they must identify the same point, just in different CRSs.

GeographicBottomHoleLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/GeographicBottomHoleLocation'. The bottom hole location of the wellbore denoted by a specified geographic horizontal coordinate reference system (Horizontal CRS), such as WGS84, NAD27, or ED50. If both GeographicBottomHoleLocation and ProjectedBottomHoleLocation properties are populated on this wellbore, they must identify the same point, just in different CRSs.

BusinessIntentionID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/BusinessIntentionID'. Business Intention [Well Business Intention] is the general purpose for which resources are approved for drilling a new well or subsequent wellbore(s).

RoleID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/RoleID'. Role [Well Role] is the current purpose, whether planned or actual. If there are multiple Roles among a wellbore's components, the well may be assigned the facet value with the highest significance. The value of Role may change over the Life Cycle.

InterestTypeID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/InterestTypeID'. Business Interest [Well Interest Type] describes whether a company currently considers a wellbore entity or its data to be a real or planned asset, and if so, the nature of and motivation for that company's interest.

HistoricalInterests.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/HistoricalInterests'. The list of past and present interests associated with the time period they were/are valid

items.title: HistoricalInterest
items.description: A 'well interest' at some time period as defined by effective and termination date.

InterestTypeID.title: Interest Type ID
InterestTypeID.description: Business Interest [Well Interest Type] describes whether a company currently considers a wellbore or its data to be a real or planned asset, and if so, the nature of and motivation for that company's interest.

EffectiveDateTime.title: Effective Date Time
EffectiveDateTime.description: The date and time at which the well interest type becomes effective.

TerminationDateTime.title: Termination Date Time
TerminationDateTime.description: The date and time at which the well interest type is no longer in effect.

WasBusinessInterestFinancialOperated.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/WasBusinessInterestFinancialOperated'. Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this Well has ever been FinancialOperated in the past.

WasBusinessInterestFinancialNonOperated.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/WasBusinessInterestFinancialNonOperated'. Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this Well has ever been FinancialNonOperated in the past.

WasBusinessInterestObligatory.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/WasBusinessInterestObligatory'. Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this Well has ever been Obligatory in the past.

WasBusinessInterestTechnical.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/WasBusinessInterestTechnical'. Identifies, for the purpose of current use, if the Business Interest [Well Interest Type] for this Well has ever been Technical in the past.

PrimaryProductTypeID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/PrimaryProductTypeID'. Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any wellbore component. A Primary Product Significance identifies the Product Type that is most significant.

SecondaryProductTypeID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/SecondaryProductTypeID'. Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any wellbore component. A Secondary Product Significance identifies the Product Type that is the second most significant.

TertiaryProductTypeID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/TertiaryProductTypeID'. Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any wellbore component. A Tertiary Product Significance identifies the Product Type that is the third most significant.

ShowProductTypeID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/ShowProductTypeID'. Product Type [Well Product Type] is the physical product(s) that can be attributed to any wellbore component. A Show Product Significance identifies a Product Type present in non-commercial quantity.

ConditionID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/ConditionID'. Condition [Well Condition] is the operational state of a wellbore component relative to the Role [Well Role].

FluidDirectionID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/FluidDirectionID'. Fluid Direction [Well Fluid Direction] is the flow direction of the wellhead stream. The facet value can change over the life of the wellbore.

OutcomeID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/OutcomeID'. Outcome [Well Drilling Outcome] is the result of attempting to accomplish the Business Intention [Well Business Intention].

StatusSummaryID.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/StatusSummaryID'. Identifies the status of a wellbore component in a way that may combine and-or summarize concepts found in other status facets. For example, a Wellbore Status Summary of Gas Injector Shut-in, which contains commonly desired business information, combines concepts from Product Type, Fluid Direction, and Condition.

WellboreCosts.description: Property. Model:'https://community.opengroup.org/osdu/data/data-definitions/-/raw/v0.30.1/Generated/master-data/Wellbore.1.5.1.json#/properties/data/allOf/3/properties/WellboreCosts'. The array of WellActivityPhaseType and associated Cost values.

items.title: WellboreCost
items.description: A cost value associated to a WellActivityPhaseType value.

ActivityTypeID.title: Well Activity Type ID
ActivityTypeID.description: The activity type, to which the Cost property is attributed to. The intended target reference-data type is WellActivityType; Wellbore:1.3.0 and Wellbore:1.4.0 used WellActivityPhaseType incorrectly.

Cost.title: Cost
Cost.description: The cost value associated with the WellActivityPhaseType.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Not an OSDU attribute (Smart Data Models addition): the GeoJSON geometry of the first feature of the OSDU WGS 84 coordinates (SpatialLocation.Wgs84Coordinates), copied so that NGSI-LD geo-queries work. The OSDU structure is kept unchanged in SpatialLocation.

AbstractAliasNames.1.0.0.title: AbstractAliasNames
AbstractAliasNames.1.0.0.description: A list of alternative names for an object.  The preferred name is in a separate, scalar property.  It may or may not be repeated in the alias list, though a best practice is to include it if the list is present, but to omit the list if there are no other names.  Note that the abstract entity is an array so the $ref to it is a simple property reference.

AliasName.description: Alternative Name value of defined name type for an object.

AliasNameTypeID.description: A classification of alias names such as by role played or type of source, such as regulatory name, regulatory code, company code, international standard name, etc.

DefinitionOrganisationID.description: The StandardsOrganisation (reference-data) or Organisation (master-data) that provided the name (the source).

EffectiveDateTime.description: The date and time when an alias name becomes effective.

TerminationDateTime.description: The data and time when an alias name is no longer in effect.

AbstractAnyCrsFeatureCollection.1.1.0.title: AbstractAnyCrsFeatureCollection
AbstractAnyCrsFeatureCollection.1.1.0.description: A schema like GeoJSON FeatureCollection with a non-WGS 84 CRS context; based on https://geojson.org/schema/FeatureCollection.json. Attention: the coordinate order is fixed: Longitude/Easting/Westing/X first, followed by Latitude/Northing/Southing/Y, optionally height as third coordinate.

CoordinateReferenceSystemID.title: Coordinate Reference System ID
CoordinateReferenceSystemID.description: The CRS reference into the CoordinateReferenceSystem catalog.

VerticalCoordinateReferenceSystemID.title: Vertical Coordinate Reference System ID
VerticalCoordinateReferenceSystemID.description: The explicit VerticalCRS reference into the CoordinateReferenceSystem catalog. This property stays empty for 2D geometries. Absent or empty values for 3D geometries mean the context may be provided by a CompoundCRS in 'CoordinateReferenceSystemID' or implicitly EPSG:5714 MSL height

VerticalUnitID.title: Vertical Unit ID
VerticalUnitID.description: The explicit vertical unit ID, referring to a reference-data--UnitOfMeasure record; this is only required for features containing 3-dimensional coordinates and undefined vertical CoordinateReferenceSystems; if a VerticalCoordinateReferenceSystemID is populated, the VerticalUnitID is given by the VerticalCoordinateReferenceSystemID's data.CoordinateSystem.VerticalAxisUnitID. The VerticalUnitID definition overrides any self-contained definition in persistableReferenceUnitZ.

persistableReferenceCrs.title: CRS Reference
persistableReferenceCrs.description: The CRS reference as persistableReference string. If populated, the CoordinateReferenceSystemID takes precedence.

persistableReferenceVerticalCrs.title: Vertical CRS Reference
persistableReferenceVerticalCrs.description: The VerticalCRS reference as persistableReference string. If populated, the VerticalCoordinateReferenceSystemID takes precedence. The property is null or empty for 2D geometries. For 3D geometries and absent or null persistableReferenceVerticalCrs the vertical CRS is either provided via persistableReferenceCrs's CompoundCRS or it is implicitly defined as EPSG:5714 MSL height.

persistableReferenceUnitZ.title: Z-Unit Reference
persistableReferenceUnitZ.description: The unit of measure for the Z-axis (only for 3-dimensional coordinates, where the CRS does not describe the vertical unit). Note that the direction is upwards positive, i.e. Z means height.

AbstractContact.1.1.0.title: Abstract Contact
AbstractContact.1.1.0.description: An object with properties that describe a specific person or other point-of-contact (like an email distribution list) that is relevant in this context (like a given data set or business project). The contact specified may be either internal or external to the organisation (something denoted via the Organisation object that is referenced). Note that some properties contain personally identifiable information, so it might not be appropriate to populate all properties in all scenarios.

EmailAddress.title: Email Address
EmailAddress.description: Contact email address. Property may be left empty where it is inappropriate to provide personally identifiable information.

PhoneNumber.title: Phone Number
PhoneNumber.description: Contact phone number. Property may be left empty where it is inappropriate to provide personally identifiable information.

RoleTypeID.title: Role Type ID
RoleTypeID.description: The identifier of a reference value for the role of the contact within the associated organisation, such as Account owner, Sales Representative, Technical Support, Project Manager, Party Chief, Client Representative, Senior Observer.

DataGovernanceRoleTypeID.title: DataGovernanceRoleTypeID
DataGovernanceRoleTypeID.description: The data governance role assigned to this contact if and only if the context has a data governance role (in context of TechnicalAssurance). The value is kept absent in all other cases.

WorkflowPersonaTypeID.title: WorkflowPersonaTypeID
WorkflowPersonaTypeID.description: The persona in context of workflows associated with this contact, as used in TechnicalAssurance.

OrganisationID.title: Organisation ID
OrganisationID.description: Reference to the company the contact is associated with.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: Name of the individual contact. Property may be left empty where it is inappropriate to provide personally identifiable information.

AbstractFacilityEvent.1.1.0.title: AbstractFacilityEvent
AbstractFacilityEvent.1.1.0.description: A significant occurrence in the life of a facility, which often changes its state, or the state of one of its components. It can describe a point-in-time (event) or a time interval of a specific type (FacilityEventType).

FacilityEventTypeID.description: The facility event type is a picklist. Examples: 'Permit', 'Spud', 'Abandon', etc.

EffectiveDateTime.description: The date and time at which the event took place or takes effect.

TerminationDateTime.description: The date and time at which the event is no longer in effect. For point-in-time events the 'TerminationDateTime' must be set equal to 'EffectiveDateTime'. Open time intervals have an absent 'TerminationDateTime'.

Remark.description: A comment or remark about the facility event.

AbstractFacilityOperator.1.1.0.title: AbstractFacilityOperator
AbstractFacilityOperator.1.1.0.description: The organisation that was responsible for a facility at some point in time.

FacilityOperatorID.title: Facility Operator ID
FacilityOperatorID.description: Internal, unique identifier for an item 'AbstractFacilityOperator'. This identifier is used by 'AbstractFacility.CurrentOperatorID' and 'AbstractFacility.InitialOperatorID'.

FacilityOperatorOrganisationID.description: The company that currently operates, or previously operated the facility

EffectiveDateTime.description: The date and time at which the facility operator becomes effective.

TerminationDateTime.description: The date and time at which the facility operator is no longer in effect. If the operator is still effective, the 'TerminationDateTime' is left absent.

Remark.description: A comment or remark about the facility operator.

AbstractFacilitySpecification.1.0.0.title: AbstractFacilitySpecification
AbstractFacilitySpecification.1.0.0.description: A property, characteristic, or attribute about a facility that is not described explicitly elsewhere.

EffectiveDateTime.description: The date and time at which the facility specification instance becomes effective.

TerminationDateTime.description: The date and time at which the facility specification instance is no longer in effect.

FacilitySpecificationQuantity.description: The value for the specified parameter type.

FacilitySpecificationDateTime.description: The actual date and time value of the parameter.

FacilitySpecificationIndicator.description: The actual indicator value of the parameter.

FacilitySpecificationText.description: The actual text value of the parameter.

UnitOfMeasureID.description: The unit for the quantity parameter, like metre (m in SI units system) for quantity Length.

ParameterTypeID.description: Parameter type of property or characteristic.

AbstractFacilityState.1.1.0.title: AbstractFacilityState
AbstractFacilityState.1.1.0.description: The life cycle status of a facility at some point in time.

EffectiveDateTime.description: The date and time at which the facility state becomes effective.

TerminationDateTime.description: The date and time at which the facility state is no longer in effect.

FacilityStateTypeID.description: Life Cycle [Facility State Type] is a set of major phases that are significant to regulators and/or business stakeholders. Life Cycle may apply to a well or its components [or other facility].

Remark.description: A comment or remark about the facility state.

AbstractFacilityVerticalMeasurement.1.0..title: AbstractFacilityVerticalMeasurement
AbstractFacilityVerticalMeasurement.1.0..description: A location along a wellbore, _usually_ associated with some aspect of the drilling of the wellbore, but not with any intersecting _subsurface_ natural surfaces.

EffectiveDateTime.description: The date and time at which a vertical measurement instance becomes effective.

VerticalMeasurement.description: The value of the elevation or depth. Depth is positive downwards from a vertical reference or geodetic datum along a path, which can be vertical; elevation is positive upwards from a geodetic datum along a vertical path. Either can be negative.

TerminationDateTime.description: The date and time at which a vertical measurement instance is no longer in effect.

VerticalMeasurementTypeID.description: Specifies the type of vertical measurement (TD, Plugback, Kickoff, Drill Floor, Rotary Table...).

VerticalMeasurementPathID.description: Specifies Measured Depth, True Vertical Depth, or Elevation.

WellboreTVDTrajectoryID.description: Specifies what directional survey or wellpath was used to calculate the TVD.

VerticalMeasurementUnitOfMeasureID.description: The unit of measure for the vertical measurement. If a unit of measure and a vertical CRS are provided, the unit of measure provided is taken over the unit of measure from the CRS.

VerticalCRSID.description: A vertical coordinate reference system defines the origin for height or depth values. It is expected that either VerticalCRSID or VerticalReferenceID reference is provided in a given vertical measurement array object, but not both.

VerticalReferenceID.description: The reference point from which the relative vertical measurement is made. This is only populated if the measurement has no VerticalCRSID specified. The value entered must match the VerticalMeasurementID for another vertical measurement array element in Wellbore or Well or in a related parent facility. The relationship should be  declared explicitly in VerticalReferenceEntityID. Any chain of measurements must ultimately resolve to a Vertical CRS. It is expected that a VerticalCRSID or a VerticalReferenceID is provided in a given vertical measurement array object, but not both.

VerticalReferenceEntityID.description: This relationship identifies the entity (aka record) in which the VerticalReferenceID is found; It could be a different OSDU entity or a self-reference. For example, a Wellbore VerticalMeasurement may reference a member of a VerticalMeasurements[] array in its parent Well record. Alternatively, VerticalReferenceEntityID may be populated with the ID of its own Wellbore record to make explicit that VerticalReferenceID is intended to be found in this record, not another.

VerticalMeasurementDescription.description: Text which describes a vertical measurement in detail.

AbstractFeatureCollection.1.0.0.description: GeoJSON feature collection as originally published in https://geojson.org/schema/FeatureCollection.json. Attention: the coordinate order is fixed: Longitude first, followed by Latitude, optionally height above MSL (EPSG:5714) as third coordinate.
AbstractFeatureCollection.1.0.0.title: GeoJSON FeatureCollection

AbstractGeoBasinContext.1.0.0.title: AbstractGeoBasinContext
AbstractGeoBasinContext.1.0.0.description: A single, typed basin entity reference, which is 'abstracted' to AbstractGeoContext and then aggregated by GeoContexts properties.

GeoTypeID.description: The BasinType reference of the Basin (via BasinID) for application convenience.

AbstractGeoContext.1.0.0.title: AbstractGeoContext
AbstractGeoContext.1.0.0.description: A geographic context to an entity. It can be either a reference to a GeoPoliticalEntity, Basin, Field, Play or Prospect.

AbstractGeoFieldContext.1.0.0.title: AbstractGeoFieldContext
AbstractGeoFieldContext.1.0.0.description: A single, typed field entity reference, which is 'abstracted' to AbstractGeoContext and then aggregated by GeoContexts properties.

GeoTypeID.description: The fixed type 'Field' for this AbstractGeoFieldContext.

AbstractGeoPlayContext.1.0.0.title: AbstractGeoPlayContext
AbstractGeoPlayContext.1.0.0.description: A single, typed Play entity reference, which is 'abstracted' to AbstractGeoContext and then aggregated by GeoContexts properties.

GeoTypeID.description: The PlayType reference of the Play (via PlayID) for application convenience.

AbstractGeoPoliticalContext.1.0.0.title: AbstractGeoPoliticalContext
AbstractGeoPoliticalContext.1.0.0.description: A single, typed geo-political entity reference, which is 'abstracted' to AbstractGeoContext and then aggregated by GeoContexts properties.

GeoTypeID.description: The GeoPoliticalEntityType reference of the GeoPoliticalEntity (via GeoPoliticalEntityID) for application convenience.

AbstractGeoProspectContext.1.0.0.title: AbstractGeoProspectContext
AbstractGeoProspectContext.1.0.0.description: A single, typed Prospect entity reference, which is 'abstracted' to AbstractGeoContext and then aggregated by GeoContexts properties.

GeoTypeID.description: The ProspectType reference of the Prospect (via ProspectID) for application convenience.

AbstractLegalParentList.1.0.0.title: Parent List
AbstractLegalParentList.1.0.0.description: A list of entity id:version references to record instances recorded in the data platform, from which the current record is derived and from which the legal tags must be derived. This structure is included by the SystemProperties "ancestry", which is part of all OSDU records. Not extensible.

parents.description: An array of none, one or many entity references of 'direct parents' in the data platform, which mark the current record as a derivative. In contrast to other relationships, the source record version is required. During record creation or update the ancestry.parents[] relationships are used to collect the legal tags from the sources and aggregate them in the legal.legaltags[] array. As a consequence, should e.g., one or more of the legal tags of the source data expire, the access to the derivatives is also terminated. For details, see ComplianceService tutorial, 'Creating derivative Records'.
parents.title: Parents

AbstractLegalTags.1.0.0.title: Legal Meta Data
AbstractLegalTags.1.0.0.description: Legal meta data like legal tags, relevant other countries, legal status. This structure is included by the SystemProperties "legal", which is part of all OSDU records. Not extensible.

legaltags.title: Legal Tags
legaltags.description: The list of legal tags, which resolve to legal properties (like country of origin, export classification code, etc.) and rules with the help of the Compliance Service.

otherRelevantDataCountries.title: Other Relevant Data Countries
otherRelevantDataCountries.description: The list of other relevant data countries as an array of two-letter country codes, see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2.

status.title: Legal Status
status.description: The legal status. Set by the system after evaluation against the compliance rules associated with the "legaltags" using the Compliance Service.

AbstractMetaItem.1.0.0.title: Frame of Reference Meta Data Item
AbstractMetaItem.1.0.0.description: A meta data item, which allows the association of named properties or property values to a Unit/Measurement/CRS/Azimuth/Time context.

kind.title: UOM Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, 'Unit' for FrameOfReferenceUOM.

name.title: UOM Unit Symbol
name.description: The unit symbol or name of the unit.

persistableReference.title: UOM Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying the Unit.

unitOfMeasureID.description: SRN to unit of measure reference.

propertyNames.title: UOM Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides Unit context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

kind.title: CRS Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, constant 'CRS' for FrameOfReferenceCRS.

persistableReference.title: CRS Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying the CRS.

propertyNames.title: CRS Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides CRS context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

kind.title: DateTime Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, constant 'DateTime', for FrameOfReferenceDateTime.

name.title: DateTime Name
name.description: The name of the DateTime format and reference.

persistableReference.title: DateTime Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying DateTime reference.

propertyNames.title: DateTime Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides DateTime context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

kind.title: AzimuthReference Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, constant 'AzimuthReference', for FrameOfReferenceAzimuthReference.

name.title: AzimuthReference Name
name.description: The name of the CRS or the symbol/name of the unit.

persistableReference.title: AzimuthReference Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying AzimuthReference.

propertyNames.title: AzimuthReference Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides AzimuthReference context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

AbstractSpatialLocation.1.1.0.title: AbstractSpatialLocation
AbstractSpatialLocation.1.1.0.description: A geographic object which can be described by a set of points.

SpatialLocationCoordinatesDate.description: Date when coordinates were measured or retrieved.

QuantitativeAccuracyBandID.description: An approximate quantitative assessment of the quality of a location (accurate to > 500 m (i.e. not very accurate)), to < 1 m, etc.

QualitativeSpatialAccuracyTypeID.description: A qualitative description of the quality of a spatial location, e.g. unverifiable, not verified, basic validation.

CoordinateQualityCheckPerformedBy.description: The user who performed the Quality Check.

CoordinateQualityCheckDateTime.description: The date of the Quality Check.

AsIngestedCoordinates.title: As Ingested Coordinates
AsIngestedCoordinates.description: The original or 'as ingested' coordinates (Point, MultiPoint, LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon or MultiPolygon). The name 'AsIngestedCoordinates' was chosen to contrast it to 'OriginalCoordinates', which carries the uncertainty whether any coordinate operations took place before ingestion. In cases where the original CRS is different from the as-ingested CRS, the AppliedOperations can also contain the list of operations applied to the coordinate prior to ingestion. The data structure is similar to GeoJSON FeatureCollection, however in a CRS context explicitly defined within the AbstractAnyCrsFeatureCollection. The coordinate sequence follows GeoJSON standard, i.e. 'eastward/longitude', 'northward/latitude' {, 'upward/height' unless overridden by an explicit direction in the AsIngestedCoordinates.VerticalCoordinateReferenceSystemID}.

Wgs84Coordinates.title: WGS 84 Coordinates
Wgs84Coordinates.description: The normalized coordinates (Point, MultiPoint, LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon or MultiPolygon) based on WGS 84 (EPSG:4326 for 2-dimensional coordinates, EPSG:4326 + EPSG:5714 (MSL) for 3-dimensional coordinates). This derived coordinate representation is intended for global discoverability only. The schema of this substructure is identical to the GeoJSON FeatureCollection https://geojson.org/schema/FeatureCollection.json. The coordinate sequence follows GeoJSON standard, i.e. longitude, latitude {, height}

AppliedOperations.title: Operations Applied
AppliedOperations.description: The audit trail of operations applied to the coordinates from the original state to the current state. The list may contain operations applied prior to ingestion as well as the operations applied to produce the Wgs84Coordinates. The text elements refer to ESRI style CRS and Transformation names, which may have to be translated to EPSG standard names.
examples: conversion from ED_1950_UTM_Zone_31N to GCS_European_1950; 1 points converted
transformation GCS_European_1950 to GCS_WGS_1984 using ED_1950_To_WGS_1984_24; 1 points successfully transformed

SpatialParameterTypeID.description: A type of spatial representation of an object, often general (e.g. an Outline, which could be applied to Field, Reservoir, Facility, etc.) or sometimes specific (e.g. Onshore Outline, State Offshore Outline, Federal Offshore Outline, 3 spatial representations that may be used by Countries).

SpatialGeometryTypeID.description: Indicates the expected look of the SpatialParameterType, e.g. Point, MultiPoint, LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon, MultiPolygon. The value constrains the type of geometries in the GeoJSON Wgs84Coordinates and AsIngestedCoordinates.

AbstractTechnicalAssurance.1.2.0.title: AbstractTechnicalAssurance
AbstractTechnicalAssurance.1.2.0.description: Describes a record's overall suitability for general business consumption based on level of trust.

TechnicalAssuranceTypeID.title: Technical Assurance Type ID
TechnicalAssuranceTypeID.description: Describes a record's overall suitability for general business consumption based on data quality. Clarifications: Since Certified is the highest classification of suitable quality, any further change or versioning of a Certified record should be carefully considered and justified. If a Technical Assurance value is not populated then one can assume the data has not been evaluated or its quality is unknown (=Unevaluated). Technical Assurance values are not intended to be used for the identification of a single "preferred" or "definitive" record by comparison with other records.

Reviewers.title: Reviewers
Reviewers.description: The individuals, or roles, that reviewed and determined the technical assurance value

AcceptableUsage.title: Acceptable Usage
AcceptableUsage.description: List of workflows and/or personas that the technical assurance value is valid for (e.g., This data is trusted for Seismic Processing)

items.title: AcceptableUsage
items.description: Describes the workflows and/or personas that the technical assurance value is valid for (e.g., This data has a technical assurance property of "trusted" and it is suitable for Seismic Interpretation).

WorkflowUsageTypeID.title: Workflow Usage Type ID
WorkflowUsageTypeID.description: Name of the business activities, processes, and/or workflows that the record's technical assurance value is valid for.

WorkflowPersonaTypeID.title: Workflow Persona Type ID
WorkflowPersonaTypeID.description: Name of the role or personas that the record's technical assurance value is valid for.

DataQualityRuleSetID.title: Data Quality Rule Set ID
DataQualityRuleSetID.description: The DataQualityRuleSet, which had to pass successfully to achieve this level of technical assurance.

DataQualityID.title: data Quality ID
DataQualityID.description: The relationship to a work-product-component--DataQuality assessment record, which was used as the basis for this decision.

ValueChainStatusTypeID.title: Value Chain Status Type ID
ValueChainStatusTypeID.description: The stage of business where the record is acceptable for workflow usage.

UnacceptableUsage.title: Unacceptable Usage
UnacceptableUsage.description: List of workflows and/or personas that the technical assurance value is not valid for (e.g., This data is not trusted for seismic interpretation)

items.title: UnacceptableUsage
items.description: Describes the workflows and/or personas that the technical assurance value is not valid for (e.g., This data has a technical assurance property of "trusted", but it is not suitable for Seismic Interpretation).

WorkflowUsageTypeID.title: Workflow Usage Type ID
WorkflowUsageTypeID.description: Name of the business activities, processes, and/or workflows that the record's technical assurance value is not valid for.

WorkflowPersonaTypeID.title: Workflow Persona Type ID
WorkflowPersonaTypeID.description: Name of the role or personas that the record is technical assurance value is not valid for.

DataQualityRuleSetID.title: Data Quality Rule Set ID
DataQualityRuleSetID.description: The DataQualityRuleSet, which did not pass successfully to achieve this level of technical assurance.

DataQualityID.title: data Quality ID
DataQualityID.description: The relationship to a work-product-component--DataQuality assessment record, which was used as the basis for this decision.

ValueChainStatusTypeID.title: Value Chain Status Type ID
ValueChainStatusTypeID.description: The stage of business where the record is not acceptable for workflow usage.

EffectiveDate.title: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.description: Date when the technical assurance determination for this record has taken place

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Any additional context to support the determination of technical assurance
examples: This is free form text from reviewer, e.g. restrictions on use

AbstractWellboreDrillingReason.1.1.1.title: AbstractWellboreDrillingReason
AbstractWellboreDrillingReason.1.1.1.description: Purpose for drilling a wellbore, which often is an indication of the level of risk.

LaheeClassID.title: Lahee Class ID
LaheeClassID.description: The Lahee classification, based on the traditional, commonly accepted, scheme to categorize wells by the general degree of risk assumed by the operator at the time of drilling.

DrillingReasonTypeID.title: Drilling Reason Type ID
DrillingReasonTypeID.description: Identifier of the drilling reason type for the corresponding time period.

EffectiveDateTime.title: Effective Date Time
EffectiveDateTime.description: The date and time at which the event becomes effective.

TerminationDateTime.title: Termination Date Time
TerminationDateTime.description: The date and time at which the event is no longer in effect.

Remark.title: Remark
Remark.description: A remark or comment explaining the drilling reason or LaheeClass assignment.
